endpoints: The user's current RF with training-selected augmentation, and real-only Small B logistic. Retain their recorded outer-training-selected parameters/High weights/augmentation and original inner/outer folds. Refit endpoints inside original inner training groups for blend selection, then on outer training data; reproduce saved outer endpoint scores. Endpoint hyperparameters and combination selection reuse the same inner folds; excluded outer students evaluate the full procedure.
selection: ensemble_f2 maximizes inner F2 then precision/recall/threshold/RF share. ensemble_recall_guard requires inner recall >= the current RF's recorded inner recall, minimizes false positives, then maximizes recall/precision/F2/threshold/RF share. Corresponding rf_threshold_only controls restrict RF share to 1. No outer result selects weights or thresholds. The inner recall guard is not an outer-recall guarantee.
interpretation: A weighted average of uncalibrated model scores, not a calibrated personal risk probability. Same existing inputs and measured >=4 study-defined High boundary. No new features, students, synthetic pools, independent evaluation cohort or deployment model. Exploratory comparison after inspecting errors on the same 97 students.
